# Localize v0.41.3 - Table of Contents

> Localization (parsing, formatting) of numbers, dates/time/calendar, units of measure, messages and lists. Includes localized collation.

## Modules

- [Localize](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.md): Locale-aware formatting, validation, and data access built on the
Unicode CLDR repository.
- [Localize.DataLoader](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.DataLoader.md): A GenServer that serializes ETF data file loading to prevent
race conditions.
- [Localize.Exception](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Exception.md): Conventions and a small behaviour shared by structured Localize
exceptions.
- [Localize.FormatCache](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.FormatCache.md): An ETS-backed cache for compiled format patterns.
- [Localize.Substitution](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Substitution.md): Compiles substitution templates of the form `"{0} something {1}"`
into token lists for efficient parameter substitution at runtime.
- [Localize.Supervisor](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Supervisor.md): The `:localize` runtime supervisor.

- Protocols
  - [Localize.Chars](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Chars.md): Protocol for locale-aware string formatting.

- Numbers
  - [Localize.Number](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Number.md): Functions for formatting numbers in a locale-aware manner.
  - [Localize.Number.Format](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Number.Format.md): Functions to manage the collection of number format patterns
defined in CLDR.
  - [Localize.Number.Format.Compiler](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Number.Format.Compiler.md): Compiles number format patterns into metadata for fast runtime
interpretation.
  - [Localize.Number.Format.Meta](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Number.Format.Meta.md): Describes the metadata that drives number formatting and
provides functions to update the struct.
  - [Localize.Number.Formatter.Ratio](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Number.Formatter.Ratio.md): Formats numbers as rational fractions using CLDR rational format patterns.
  - [Localize.Number.Parser](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Number.Parser.md): Functions for parsing numbers and currencies from strings
in a locale-aware manner.
  - [Localize.Number.PluralRule](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Number.PluralRule.md): Defines plural rule modules for cardinal and ordinal number
categories according to the CLDR plural rules specification.
  - [Localize.Number.PluralRule.Cardinal](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Number.PluralRule.Cardinal.md): Implements cardinal plural rules for numbers.
  - [Localize.Number.PluralRule.Ordinal](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Number.PluralRule.Ordinal.md): Implements ordinal plural rules for numbers.
  - [Localize.Number.Rbnf](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Number.Rbnf.md): Rules-Based Number Formatting (RBNF) for algorithmic number
systems and spellout forms.
  - [Localize.Number.Symbol](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Number.Symbol.md): Functions to manage the number symbol definitions for a locale
and number system.
  - [Localize.Number.System](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Number.System.md): Functions to manage number systems for a locale.
  - [Localize.Number.Transliterate](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Number.Transliterate.md): Functions to transliterate digits between number systems.

- Dates and Times
  - [Localize.Date](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Date.md): Provides localized formatting of `Date` structs and date-like maps.
  - [Localize.DateTime](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.DateTime.md): Provides localized formatting of `DateTime`, `NaiveDateTime`,
and datetime-like maps.
  - [Localize.DateTime.Relative](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.DateTime.Relative.md): Formats relative time strings such as "3 days ago", "tomorrow",
or "in 10 seconds".
  - [Localize.DateTime.Timezone](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.DateTime.Timezone.md): Provides timezone data access and timezone formatting for CLDR
date/time format symbols.
  - [Localize.Duration](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Duration.md): Functions to create and format durations — the difference
between two dates, times, or datetimes expressed in calendar
units.
  - [Localize.Interval](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Interval.md): Formats date and time intervals as localized strings.
  - [Localize.Time](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Time.md): Provides localized formatting of `Time` structs and time-like maps.

- Locale
  - [Localize.Locale](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Locale.md): Locale utility functions for resolution, validation, and
per-locale data access.
  - [Localize.Locale.Loader](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Locale.Loader.md): A GenServer that serializes locale data loading to prevent
race conditions.
  - [Localize.Locale.LocaleDisplay](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Locale.LocaleDisplay.md): Implements the CLDR locale display name algorithm to format
locale identifiers for presentation.
  - [Localize.Locale.Provider](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Locale.Provider.md): Defines the behaviour for locale data providers.
  - [Localize.Locale.Provider.Cache](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Locale.Provider.Cache.md): On-disk cache for downloaded locale data files.
  - [Localize.Locale.Provider.PersistentTerm](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Locale.Provider.PersistentTerm.md): A locale data provider that stores locale data in `:persistent_term`.

- Language Tag
  - [Localize.LanguageTag](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.LanguageTag.md): Represents a language tag as defined in [rfc5646](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5646)
with extensions "u" and "t" as defined in [BCP 47](https://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47).
  - [Localize.LanguageTag.Parser](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.LanguageTag.Parser.md): Parses a CLDR language tag (also referred to as locale string).
  - [Localize.LanguageTag.Sigil](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.LanguageTag.Sigil.md): Implements a `sigil_l/2` macro for
constructing `t:Localize.LanguageTag` structs.
  - [Localize.LanguageTag.T](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.LanguageTag.T.md): Defines the struct for the BCP 47 `t`
extension.
  - [Localize.LanguageTag.U](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.LanguageTag.U.md): Defines the struct for the BCP 47 `u`
extension.
  - [Localize.Rfc5646.Parser](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Rfc5646.Parser.md): Implements parsing for [RFC5646](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5646) language
tags with [BCP47](https://tools.ietf.org/search/bcp47) extensions.

- Calendars
  - [Localize.Calendar](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Calendar.md): Calendar localization functions for retrieving locale-specific
names for eras, months, days, quarters, and day periods.

- Currencies
  - [Localize.Currency](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Currency.md): Defines a currency structure and functions to manage currency
codes, validate currencies, and retrieve currency metadata.

- Languages
  - [Localize.Language](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Language.md): Provides language name localization functions built on the
Unicode CLDR repository.

- Territories
  - [Localize.Territory](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Territory.md): Provides territory and subdivision localization functions
built on the Unicode CLDR repository.
  - [Localize.Territory.Subdivision](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Territory.Subdivision.md): Territory subdivision localization functions.

- Scripts
  - [Localize.Script](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Script.md): Provides script name localization functions built on the
Unicode CLDR repository.

- Units of Measure
  - [Localize.Unit](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Unit.md): Represents and formats CLDR units of measure.
  - [Localize.Unit.BaseUnit](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Unit.BaseUnit.md): Converts parsed unit ASTs into their CLDR base unit equivalents.
  - [Localize.Unit.Canonical](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Unit.Canonical.md): Canonicalises CLDR unit identifier ASTs and names.
  - [Localize.Unit.Conversion](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Unit.Conversion.md): Converts numeric values between CLDR units of measure.
  - [Localize.Unit.Conversion.Beaufort](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Unit.Conversion.Beaufort.md): Nonlinear conversion between the Beaufort wind force scale and
meters per second.
  - [Localize.Unit.CustomRegistry](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Unit.CustomRegistry.md): Runtime registry for user-defined units backed by `:persistent_term`.
  - [Localize.Unit.Data](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Unit.Data.md): Compile-time extraction of CLDR unit data from a pre-built ETF file.
  - [Localize.Unit.Math](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Unit.Math.md): Arithmetic operations on `Localize.Unit` structs.
  - [Localize.Unit.Operators](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Unit.Operators.md): Overloaded arithmetic operators for `Localize.Unit.t()` values.
  - [Localize.Unit.Parser](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Unit.Parser.md): Parses CLDR Unit of Measure identifier strings into structured ASTs.
  - [Localize.Unit.Preference](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Unit.Preference.md): Returns the preferred units for a given unit, territory, and usage.

- Messages
  - [Localize.Message](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Message.md): Implements [ICU MessageFormat 2](https://unicode.org/reports/tr35/tr35-messageFormat.html)
with functions to parse and interpolate messages.
  - [Localize.Message.Formatter](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Message.Formatter.md): Dispatch module for rendering MF2 highlight tokens.
  - [Localize.Message.Formatter.ANSI](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Message.Formatter.ANSI.md): ANSI terminal formatter for MF2 highlight tokens.
  - [Localize.Message.Formatter.HTML](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Message.Formatter.HTML.md): HTML formatter for MF2 highlight tokens.
  - [Localize.Message.Formatter.Plain](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Message.Formatter.Plain.md): Plain-text formatter for MF2 highlight tokens.
  - [Localize.Message.Formatter.Plugin](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Message.Formatter.Plugin.md): [`mix format`](https://hexdocs.pm/mix/Mix.Tasks.Format.html) plugin that
canonicalises ICU MessageFormat 2 (MF2) messages.
  - [Localize.Message.Function](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Message.Function.md): Behaviour for custom MF2 formatting functions.
  - [Localize.Message.Highlighter](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Message.Highlighter.md): Produces a classified token stream from an MF2 AST for syntax
highlighting.
  - [Localize.Message.Interpreter](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Message.Interpreter.md): Interprets a MessageFormat 2 AST and produces formatted output.
  - [Localize.Message.JSON](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Message.JSON.md): Converts between MF2 ASTs and the JSON interchange data model
defined in [TR35 §8](https://www.unicode.org/reports/tr35/tr35-messageFormat.html).
  - [Localize.Message.Parser](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Message.Parser.md): Implements a parser for
[ICU MessageFormat 2](https://unicode.org/reports/tr35/tr35-messageFormat.html).
  - [Localize.Message.Print](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Message.Print.md): Converts a MessageFormat 2 AST back to its canonical string form.
  - [Localize.Message.Sigils](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Message.Sigils.md): Implements sigils for ICU MessageFormat 2 messages.

- Gettext
  - [Localize.Gettext](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Gettext.md): Gettext backend for the Localize library.
  - [Localize.Gettext.Interpolation](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Gettext.Interpolation.md): Gettext interpolation module for ICU MessageFormat 2 (MF2) messages.

- Lists
  - [Localize.List](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.List.md): Formats lists into locale-aware strings using CLDR list
formatting patterns.
  - [Localize.List.Pattern](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.List.Pattern.md): Defines the structure for list formatting patterns.

- Collation
  - [Localize.Collation](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.md): Implements the Unicode Collation Algorithm (UCA) as extended by CLDR.
  - [Localize.Collation.Element](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.Element.md): A Collation Element (CE) with primary, secondary, and tertiary weights.
  - [Localize.Collation.FastLatin](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.FastLatin.md): Fast lookup table for Basic Latin and Latin Extended-A codepoints.
  - [Localize.Collation.Han](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.Han.md): Han character ordering using radical-stroke indexes.
  - [Localize.Collation.ImplicitWeights](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.ImplicitWeights.md): Computes implicit collation elements for codepoints not in the DUCET/CLDR allkeys table.
  - [Localize.Collation.Insensitive](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.Insensitive.md): Case-insensitive string comparator for use with `Enum.sort/2`.
  - [Localize.Collation.Nif](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.Nif.md): Collation NIF interface providing high-performance Unicode collation via ICU4C.
  - [Localize.Collation.Normalizer](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.Normalizer.md): Unicode NFD normalization for collation.
Delegates to Erlang's `:unicode` module.
  - [Localize.Collation.Numeric](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.Numeric.md): Numeric collation support (kn=true / numeric=true).
  - [Localize.Collation.Options](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.Options.md): Collation options corresponding to BCP47 -u- extension keys.
  - [Localize.Collation.Reorder](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.Reorder.md): Script reordering for collation (kr= / reorder option).
  - [Localize.Collation.Sensitive](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.Sensitive.md): Case-sensitive string comparator for use with `Enum.sort/2`.
  - [Localize.Collation.SortKey](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.SortKey.md): Constructs binary sort keys from processed collation elements.
  - [Localize.Collation.Table](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.Table.md): Persistent-term-backed collation element table.
  - [Localize.Collation.Table.Parser](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.Table.Parser.md): Parses the FractionalUCA.txt file into a map of codepoint sequences to collation elements.
  - [Localize.Collation.Tailoring](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.Tailoring.md): CLDR locale-specific collation tailoring.
  - [Localize.Collation.Tailoring.LocaleDefaults](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.Tailoring.LocaleDefaults.md): Preset collation option defaults for common locales.
  - [Localize.Collation.Variable](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Collation.Variable.md): Variable weight handling for the collation algorithm.

- Utilities
  - [Localize.Utils](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Utils.md): Utility functions and namespace for Localize utility submodules.
  - [Localize.Utils.Decimal](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Utils.Decimal.md): Compatibility layer for `Decimal` library operations.
  - [Localize.Utils.Digits](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Utils.Digits.md): Abstract representation of number (integer, float, Decimal) in tuple form
and functions for transformations on number parts.
  - [Localize.Utils.Enum](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Utils.Enum.md): Enumerable utility functions not provided in the standard library.
  - [Localize.Utils.Helpers](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Utils.Helpers.md): General purpose helper functions for Localize.
  - [Localize.Utils.Http](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Utils.Http.md): Supports securely downloading HTTPS content.
  - [Localize.Utils.Json](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Utils.Json.md): JSON decoding utilities wrapping the OTP `:json` module.
  - [Localize.Utils.Map](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Utils.Map.md): Functions for transforming maps, keys and values.
  - [Localize.Utils.Math](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Utils.Math.md): Mathematical helper functions for number formatting and
Localize subsystems.
  - [Localize.Utils.String](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Utils.String.md): String manipulation functions not provided in the standard library.

- NIF
  - [Localize.Nif](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.Nif.md): Optional NIF interface to ICU4C for high-performance locale operations.

- Exceptions
  - [Localize.BindError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.BindError.md): Exception raised when interpreting a message and one or more
variable bindings are missing.
  - [Localize.CurrencyNoDisplayNameError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.CurrencyNoDisplayNameError.md): Exception raised when a currency has no display name
available for the requested locale.
  - [Localize.CurrencyNotLocalizedError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.CurrencyNotLocalizedError.md): Exception raised when a known currency code has no localized
data in the requested locale.
  - [Localize.DateTimeFormatError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.DateTimeFormatError.md): Exception raised when a date, time, or datetime format
pattern cannot be processed.
  - [Localize.DateTimeIntervalFormatError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.DateTimeIntervalFormatError.md): Exception raised when an interval format cannot be resolved.
  - [Localize.DateTimeInvalidInputError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.DateTimeInvalidInputError.md): Exception raised when a date, time, or datetime value does not
have the required keys for formatting.
  - [Localize.DateTimeUnresolvedFormatError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.DateTimeUnresolvedFormatError.md): Exception raised when a date, time, or datetime format
skeleton cannot be resolved to a pattern for the given locale.
  - [Localize.FormatError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.FormatError.md): Exception raised when a value cannot be formatted by the requested
message format function due to an incompatible type or missing
configuration.
  - [Localize.InvalidLocaleError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.InvalidLocaleError.md): Exception raised when a locale identifier cannot be parsed
into a valid language tag.
  - [Localize.InvalidSubtagError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.InvalidSubtagError.md): Exception raised when an extension key or value is not valid
for a BCP 47 language tag.
  - [Localize.InvalidValueError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.InvalidValueError.md): Exception raised when a value does not meet the expected type
or constraints for an operation.
  - [Localize.ItemNotFoundError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.ItemNotFoundError.md): Exception raised when a key path cannot be resolved in
locale data.
  - [Localize.LikelySubtagsError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.LikelySubtagsError.md): Exception raised when likely subtags data cannot be found
for a given locale identifier.
  - [Localize.LocaleCacheDirError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.LocaleCacheDirError.md): Exception raised when the `:locale_cache_dir` or `:otp_app`
application environment keys are misconfigured.
  - [Localize.LocaleCacheWriteError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.LocaleCacheWriteError.md): Exception raised when a locale file cannot be written to the
locale cache directory.
  - [Localize.LocaleDisplayError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.LocaleDisplayError.md): Exception raised when locale display name data is not
available for a requested locale.
  - [Localize.LocaleDownloadError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.LocaleDownloadError.md): Exception raised when a locale file cannot be downloaded from
its remote URL.
  - [Localize.LocaleIsStaleError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.LocaleIsStaleError.md): Exception raised when a cached locale file's version does not
match the current `Localize.version/0`.
  - [Localize.LocaleMatchError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.LocaleMatchError.md): Exception raised when no matching locale can be found
within the specified distance threshold.
  - [Localize.LocaleNotFoundInCacheError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.LocaleNotFoundInCacheError.md): Exception raised when a locale file is not found in the locale
cache directory, or cannot be read for another I/O reason.
  - [Localize.NoCertificateStoreError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.NoCertificateStoreError.md): Exception raised when no certificate trust store can be located.
  - [Localize.NoParentError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.NoParentError.md): Exception raised when a parent locale is requested for the
root locale (`und`) which has no parent.
  - [Localize.NoParentTerritoryError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.NoParentTerritoryError.md): Exception raised when a territory has no parent container
in the CLDR territory containment data.
  - [Localize.NoPracticalDifferenceError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.NoPracticalDifferenceError.md): Exception raised when two date or datetime values are considered
equal at every field used by `Localize.Interval.greatest_difference/2`,
so no greater-than-zero interval field can be returned.
  - [Localize.ParseError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.ParseError.md): Exception raised when a language tag, unit identifier, or MF2 message
cannot be parsed.
  - [Localize.UnitConversionError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnitConversionError.md): Exception raised when a unit conversion cannot be performed.
  - [Localize.UnitNoValueError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnitNoValueError.md): Exception raised when a unit operation requires a numeric value
but the unit struct has `nil` as its value.
  - [Localize.UnitPreferenceError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnitPreferenceError.md): Exception raised when a unit preference cannot be determined
for a given unit, region, or usage combination.
  - [Localize.UnknownCalendarError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnknownCalendarError.md): Exception raised when a calendar name is not a known
CLDR calendar type.
  - [Localize.UnknownCurrencyError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnknownCurrencyError.md): Exception raised when a currency code is not a known
ISO 4217 or registered custom currency.
  - [Localize.UnknownLanguageError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnknownLanguageError.md): Exception raised when a language code cannot be found in
the locale display name data.
  - [Localize.UnknownLocaleError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnknownLocaleError.md): Exception raised when a locale identifier does not correspond
to any known CLDR locale.
  - [Localize.UnknownMeasurementSystemError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnknownMeasurementSystemError.md): Exception raised when a measurement system type is not a
known CLDR measurement system.
  - [Localize.UnknownNumberSystemError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnknownNumberSystemError.md): Exception raised when a number system name is not a known
CLDR number system.
  - [Localize.UnknownPluralRulesError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnknownPluralRulesError.md): Exception raised when no plural rules are available for
a given locale.
  - [Localize.UnknownRbnfRuleError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnknownRbnfRuleError.md): Exception raised when an RBNF rule name cannot be resolved for
a given locale.
  - [Localize.UnknownScriptError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnknownScriptError.md): Exception raised when a script code is not a known
ISO 15924 or CLDR script subtag.
  - [Localize.UnknownStyleError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnknownStyleError.md): Exception raised when a display name style is not one of
the known styles (`:short`, `:standard`, `:variant`).
  - [Localize.UnknownSubdivisionError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnknownSubdivisionError.md): Exception raised when a territory subdivision code is
not a known ISO 3166-2 subdivision.
  - [Localize.UnknownTerritoryError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnknownTerritoryError.md): Exception raised when a territory code is not a known
ISO 3166 territory or CLDR region code.
  - [Localize.UnknownTimezoneError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnknownTimezoneError.md): Exception raised when a timezone identifier cannot be resolved
to a known IANA timezone.
  - [Localize.UnknownUnitError](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Localize.UnknownUnitError.md): Exception raised when a unit identifier cannot be resolved
to a known CLDR unit.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix localize.download_locales](https://localize.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Localize.DownloadLocales.md): Downloads locale ETF files from the Localize CDN and stores
them in the configured locale cache directory.
